```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: stable
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo install --force bench.sh

    - name: Run benchmarks
      id: benchmarks
      run: |
        bench.sh --json > results.json

    - name: Commit and push benchmark results
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
        git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
        git checkout -b perf
        echo "::add-matrix::branch=perf"
        echo "::set-output name=commit_hash::${{ github.sha }}"
        echo "::set-output name=results_file::results.json"
        git add results.json
        git commit -m "Update benchmarks"
        git push origin perf

    - name: Summarize benchmark results
      run: |
        echo "::group::Benchmark Results"
        cat ${{ steps.benchmarks.outputs.results_file }}
        echo "::endgroup::"
```
